notes: Catches a sweep that was timed against the wrong sound before it is saved, and restarts the lossless stream where some receivers mis-timed the channel measured after a quieter seat sweep. Automatic switching with three or four subwoofers is faster, a PC whose clock runs unusually fast or slow no longer asks for a repeat on every speaker, and two messages that blamed the wrong thing have been corrected. GSonic also lists any PC settings worth correcting before you measure. Your existing measurements remain valid - nothing about how a sweep is measured or how a result is calculated has changed. Install over your current version, settings carry over.
